assumptions.description: All furniture sizes, materials, people, lighting and positions are proposed, not surveyed. Original ERP geometry and assumptions remain unchanged.

Far end means the east end of Jeu principal, x1710–1920. The house has a115cm raised play deck,252cm overall height and no bed. Stairs/slide, guarding and headroom require specialist design before fabrication; displayed children are scale figures.

Dual-purpose transverse counter:60cm low registration hatch and102cm coffee cabinet, both55cm deep; one operator behind with85cm floor aisle in the retained211.5cm-high alcove. Water, drainage, power and equipment remain provisional.

Upstairs people remain unchanged. Downstairs: five or six waiting adults, plus one operator, with actual mesh stature and breadth normalized independently. This is a spatial study, not an authorized occupancy/staffing calculation.
Upstairs playhouse and navigation remain unchanged. Downstairs customers have body-sized collision proxies when shown. Queue must clear for platform boarding.

Queue study uses60x60cm waiting cells and a90cm local passage/entrance-turn target. Five adults fit tightly in two short files; the sixth intrudes into the entrance turning target. No stroller, luggage, whole-family or regulatory capacity allowance.

Coffee plan/overview temporarily clips the existing facade and hides the alcove ceiling for a cutaway. Those original surfaces return in first person and other views; their geometry is unchanged. Staff hatch60cm nominal, alcove headroom211.5cm and services require site verification.
